title: ElevatorModRemake
description: A slapdash remake of the Elevator Mod from early Minecraft.
body: # Functioning normal, alt angle, and a blocked path This was a rather slapdash mod, it brings back the elevator mod functionality and remasters it, allowing users to traverse freely up or down- **does not support sideways** movement. ![Recipe: 3 wool on top, 1 wool left, 1 ender eye middle, 1 wool right, 3 wool on bottom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29a4a7ca4a19895b29054d80ec8eca4af29a290f.png)
